tagline.en: The shortest two-digit Interstate, all of it in one county
tagline.zh: 最短的两位数州际公路，全线只在一个县内

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: US 50 and US 301 at Parole, near Annapolis, Maryland
start.zh: 马里兰州安纳波利斯附近的帕罗尔，与 US 50、US 301 相接

end.en: I-695 at Brooklyn Park, near Baltimore, Maryland
end.zh: 马里兰州巴尔的摩附近的布鲁克林帕克，与 I-695 相接

en: I-97 is the commuter road between Annapolis and Baltimore, and it is the shortest completed two-digit Interstate in the country. Every mile of it lies in Anne Arundel County, Maryland — the only two-digit Interstate in the contiguous states entirely inside a single county — and it touches no other two-digit Interstate at either end.

It serves Crownsville, Millersville, Severna Park, Glen Burnie and Ferndale, and it is the main road to Baltimore/Washington International Airport from the state capital. The southern four miles have no interchanges at all, a concession to local worries about what access would do to the land beside them, which gives the approach to Annapolis a rural feel unusual for a road this busy.

Most of it is not new. Only the southernmost section follows a fresh alignment; the rest is the old MD 3 corridor and, at the north end, the Glen Burnie Bypass of the early 1960s, both rebuilt in place to Interstate standard.
zh: I-97 是安纳波利斯与巴尔的摩之间的通勤公路，也是全国最短的、已建成的两位数州际公路。它每一英里都位于马里兰州安妮阿伦德尔县境内——是美国本土唯一全线在单一县内的两位数州际公路——而且两端都不与任何其他两位数州际公路相接。
它服务克朗斯维尔、米勒斯维尔、塞弗纳帕克、格伦伯尼与弗恩代尔，也是自州首府前往巴尔的摩—华盛顿国际机场的主要道路。最南端四英里完全没有互通，这是对当地担忧的一项让步——担心出入口会改变沿路土地的面貌——也因此让通往安纳波利斯的引道带有一种对于这样繁忙的道路而言并不常见的乡野气息。
它大部分并非新建。只有最南端一段走的是全新线位；其余是原 MD 3 走廊，北端则是 1960 年代初的格伦伯尼绕道，两者都在原地重建至州际公路标准。

en: The corridor took two decades to settle. A freeway called the Annapolis Expressway, on a line east of the Severn River, was studied from 1956 and then cut back after community opposition. A Baltimore–Annapolis study in 1978 compared that eastern corridor with a western one on the MD 3 line and found the western route served traffic better while displacing about a third as many homes and businesses.

The number itself moved around. AASHTO approved I-97 north of US 50 in November 1975, alongside a proposed I-297 over MD 3 and an I-197 spur; a planned I-68 along US 50 west of Annapolis was later dropped in favour of I-595 so that Maryland and West Virginia could use I-68 for the road between Morgantown and Hancock. What survived all of that was I-97 alone.

Construction ran from 1984 to late 1997 — the southern section to Annapolis opened in 1989, the middle in the early 1990s, and the Glen Burnie Bypass upgrade finished the job. Money released by cancelled highway projects in the Baltimore and Washington areas is what made it buildable. The road carries no official name, but in 1998 the legislature dedicated it to state senator John A. Cade, who had secured much of its funding and who died in 1996.
zh: 这条走廊花了二十年才定案。一条名为「安纳波利斯快速路」的高速公路，线位在塞文河以东，自 1956 年起接受研究，后因社区反对而缩减。1978 年的一项巴尔的摩—安纳波利斯研究，将该东线走廊与沿 MD 3 的西线走廊作比较，结论是西线更能满足交通需求，同时拆迁的住宅与商铺仅约为东线的三分之一。
编号本身也几经变动。AASHTO 于 1975 年 11 月批准了 US 50 以北的 I-97，同时还有沿 MD 3 的 I-297 方案与一条 I-197 支线；原计划沿安纳波利斯以西 US 50 的 I-68 后来被放弃，改为 I-595，以便马里兰州与西弗吉尼亚州把 I-68 用于摩根敦至汉考克之间的道路。在这一切之后留存下来的，只有 I-97。
施工自 1984 年持续到 1997 年末——通往安纳波利斯的南段于 1989 年通车，中段在 1990 年代初，格伦伯尼绕道的改造则为工程收尾。使它得以建成的资金，来自巴尔的摩与华盛顿地区被取消的公路项目所释放的额度。这条路没有官方名称，但州议会于 1998 年将其题献给州参议员约翰·A·凯德——他为该路争取了大量资金，并已于 1996 年去世。

why.en: A figure of about $450 million at completion in 1997, against roughly $225 million when the FHWA announced the route in 1979, circulates in secondary compilations of Maryland State Highway Administration material. No primary agency accounting was located for this entry, so no value is given.
why.zh: 在对马里兰州公路管理局资料的二手汇编中，流传着这样的数字：1997 年建成时约 4.5 亿美元，而 1979 年联邦公路管理局公布该路线时约为 2.25 亿美元。本条目未能找到官方机构的原始核算，故不给出数值。

value.en: 17.62 miles, entirely in Maryland and entirely within Anne Arundel County
value.zh: 17.62 英里，全线位于马里兰州，且全在安妮阿伦德尔县境内

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Figures of roughly 105,000 vehicles a day north of MD 32 and 75,000 south of it are quoted in secondary compilations attributing them to the Maryland State Highway Administration, but the underlying agency count could not be retrieved for this entry.
why.zh: 二手汇编中引用的数字为：MD 32 以北每日约 105,000 辆、以南约 75,000 辆，并称出自马里兰州公路管理局；但本条目无法调取其原始的机构统计数据。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves the I-97 designation north of US 50 in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，AASHTO 批准 US 50 以北的 I-97 编号。

timeline.en: A Baltimore–Annapolis study selects the western corridor on the MD 3 line over the Annapolis Expressway.
timeline.zh: 一项巴尔的摩—安纳波利斯研究选定沿 MD 3 的西线走廊，放弃安纳波利斯快速路。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the new southern section.
The section from US 50/301 north to the MD 3 and MD 32 junction opens.
timeline.zh: 自 US 50/301 北至 MD 3 与 MD 32 交汇处的路段通车。

timeline.en: The Glen Burnie Bypass upgrade is finished, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 格伦伯尼绕道改造完工，本路线全线建成。

timeline.en: The Maryland General Assembly dedicates the road to senator John A. Cade.
timeline.zh: 马里兰州议会将该路题献给参议员约翰·A·凯德。
